name: FED-03 ISS pursuit, restart, target-removal and concurrent settlement verification

tests.name: Reconnect ordinary ISS target after server restart
Reconnect removed-target player after server restart
Invoke the authoritative NPC/ISS scheduler handler
Read target ship through ordinary authenticated session
Assert pursuit combat, incident persistence, target removal, one concurrent settlement and ISS movement

data.sql: SELECT (SELECT status='pursuing' FROM npc_security_incidents WHERE idempotency_key='qa:fed-iss-pursuit:eligible')::int,(SELECT shields=90 AND sector_id=300 FROM ships WHERE ship_id=(SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE name='fed_iss_target_qa'))::int,(SELECT COUNT(*)=1 FROM npc_action_log WHERE faction='ISS' AND action_type='attack' AND target_player_id=(SELECT player_id FROM players WHERE name='fed_iss_target_qa') AND sector_id=300)::int,(SELECT status='pursuing' FROM npc_security_incidents WHERE idempotency_key='qa:fed-iss-pursuit:removed')::int,(SELECT COUNT(*)=0 FROM npc_action_log WHERE faction='ISS' AND action_type='attack' AND target_player_id=(SELECT player_id FROM players WHERE name='fed_iss_removed_qa'))::int,(SELECT p.sector_id=(SELECT origin_sector_id FROM npc_security_incidents WHERE idempotency_key='qa:fed-iss-pursuit:moving') AND p.sector_id>10 FROM players p WHERE p.player_id=(SELECT player_id FROM players WHERE lower(name)='iss'))::int;
